nodes.label: CKKS Fully Homomorphic Encryption Framework for Private Vector Arithmetic
nodes.description: Cheon-Kim-Kim-Song (CKKS) homomorphic encryption scheme enabling approximate floating-point vector arithmetic directly over encrypted graph embeddings without decrypting underlying features.

nodes.label: GATv2 Dynamic Attention Weighting Layer for Graph Neural Networks
nodes.description: Dynamic Graph Attention Network architecture resolving static attention bottlenecks by computing query-key projections after non-linear aggregation for complex link prediction.

nodes.label: ISO/IEC 39788 Database Languages — Graph Query Language (GQL)
nodes.description: International standard defining declarative pattern matching, path traversal expressions, and explicit graph schema definitions for standardized property graph databases.

nodes.label: Neural Vowel & Diacritic Restoration Kernel for Modern Standard Arabic
nodes.description: BiLSTM-Transformer hybrid model restoring full short vowels and diacritical marks (Tashkeel) to ambiguous Arabic surface tokens prior to entity embedding and linking.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL 3.1) Coherent Memory Subsystem
nodes.description: High-bandwidth, low-latency open industry interconnect standard allowing GPUs, TPUs, and CPUs to pool dynamic memory across PCIe 6.0 buses for multi-terabyte in-memory graph caching.
